static_arm_semantics.fixed_population: Physical commissioning probes run but observations never fitted. New nominal updater; geometry/beta/residual fixed in TASK. State observer still observes causal measurements. No individual fit/update.
static_arm_semantics.commissioning_only: Individual measured geometry fit and dynamic/residual commissioning replay. All frozen during TASK.
static_arm_semantics.continual_adaptive: Same commissioning replay; geometry frozen; beta and residual update at existing 20ms opportunities under existing acceptance constraints.

model_numeric_hash_schema: SHA256 little-endian f64 beta + residual; geometry signature recorded separately. Planner worker payload must be reconstructed from retained adaptive_state rather than trusting wrapper counters. Mechanics belief_sequence cross-linked to payload hash. Execution command wrappers record actual self.human_model.
prediction_definition: Observed transmitted torque minus regressor prediction before residual correction is in-sample characterization, not held-out forecast; also record after-residual prediction on same causal samples and q/dq/ddq/torque/time ranges. No extra diagnostic data or cross-arm observations allowed.
truth_firewall: HiddenHumanV2 passed only to plant setup and static evaluation; controller prior via high_rom_deployable_prior. No frozen truth handoff to planner/model fit.
